_comment: Vocabulary substitution table for the Codex AGENTS.md managed block (lib/targets/codex.js). Applied longest-key-first over CLAUDE.layer.md + CLAUDE.personal.md + no-paths rules text. An unknown term is left untouched. Most keys are single terms; the one clause-length key exists because a sentence that names BOTH harnesses ('Claude Code は …、Codex/omp は …') renders as a contradiction once 'Claude Code' becomes 'Codex' — collapsing the whole clause is the only substitution that reads correctly on Codex. Longest-key-first ordering makes it win over the plain 'Workflow tool' entry. If the source sentence is reworded the key stops matching and the rendering degrades to merely redundant, never wrong.
